MATCH (pump:PlantItem {tag: 'P-33901B'})-[:send_to*1..]->(equipment:Equipment)
WHERE equipment <> pump
WITH pump, collect(DISTINCT equipment) AS downstream
UNWIND downstream AS target
MATCH path = (pump)-[:send_to*1..]->(target)
UNWIND nodes(path) AS item
WITH DISTINCT item
WHERE item.tag IS NOT NULL
  AND any(label IN labels(item) WHERE label IN [
    'GateValve', 'BallValve', 'GlobeValve', 'AngleBallValve',
    'AngleGlobeValve', 'AnglePlugValve', 'AngleValve', 'ButterflyValve',
    'PlugValve', 'NeedleValve', 'StraightwayValve'
  ])
RETURN item.tag AS tag
ORDER BY tag
